name: Ariel Morse
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember a campaign meeting where nobody had dirty fingers.” Thursday often includes a stop at the bank steps, where Ariel takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I funded the advert and expected elegant hands. The photographer asked me who I imagine has earned elegance.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a mustard canvas overshirt and a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. Ariel has a long face and high cheekbones, with a high puff tied with plain cord. Ariel presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Ariel has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To fund an advert the model recognizes as fair.
family: Kai Shah is Ariel’s cousin raised in the same household. Ariel calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Kai leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *A wall of birthdays*, Kai says, “I came to negotiate a sale and discovered my own childhood nickname behind the radiator.”
connections: Silas Voss. The investor cannot approve the campaign until the copywriter replaces its presumptions.
